invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a new TiledMap and returns it as 'map', hence result (the returned TiledMap) is never null.
The method relies on 'tmxFile' (a FileHandle) to load TMX data; it is a required file handle input and cannot be null for normal operation.
The method requires 'imageResolver' to load tilesets and images; it is passed as an argument and assumed to be non-null.
The TiledMap's properties are set during method execution and are a core part of the TiledMap object; the method does not unset or null out properties.
The TiledMap's layers collection is initialized and populated throughout the method execution and is not set to null.
